transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Morning. Zoe's not here yet, we start anyway. Lin, logs?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: I went through them. The trip on channel two lines up with a supply sag, not the actuator. Every channel on that power strip dipped at the same time, the others just didn't cross the threshold.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: So it's the building.

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Or the strip. I moved it to the other circuit and it's been clean since.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: That strip is the one with the chamber on it too. I told facilities about that!!

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. Keep it on the other circuit. Andre.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: swapped the amp yesterday. offset's gone. like, basically gone, its within noise now. so it was the amp

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Nice.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: im gonna label the bad one so nobody grabs it again

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Label it and put it in the cage. Carlos.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Leg subassembly is torqued, cables dressed. Destiny did most of it. Waiting on a final look from Nora before it goes on the stand.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: I can look at it right after this. Is it on the cart by the door or still on the bench?

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Still on the bench, I didn't want to move it before the check

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: opened the boxes from friday. one was ours, one was for the electronics team, i walked it over

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Was ours complete?

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: packing slip matched. didnt count the screws

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: harness today. carlos what do you want first, the leg one or the spare

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Leg one.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ok

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Two things from me. First, I updated the kit list yesterday, so if anyone was working off a printout, please throw it out. Second, I'm still waiting on purchasing for the fastener confirmation, I'll chase again today.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Oh, the hand press is leaking oil again, there's a puddle under it

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Again? I'll put a pan under it. We need to get that seal done.

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: i can look at it fri if its slow

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: hey, sorry, sorry. parking. what did i miss

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Your update. Go.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok uh clamp plate, i shimmed it last night actually, it's flat now. going on the stand this afternoon after andre

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: im done with the stand by noon

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: perfect

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay. The ring, we need 12, by 10/23. Write it down.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: 12 by, sorry, 10/23?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok. thats fine

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Do those go to life test after or straight to the build?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: We'll decide later.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: unrelated but did anyone see the dyno firmware update email. do we have to do that

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Not mid-test. I'd hold until the life test run finishes.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Hold it.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Also the forklift guy is coming Thursday, so clear the aisle by the dock.

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: thats mostly my stuff. ill move it

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Dmitri, just to confirm what you said earlier, the ring quantity, is that on top of what's already on the kit list or does that replace it?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Separate. Don't touch the kit list.

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Okay, understood.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Last one. We need FL-TST-2716 by 9/29. Five of them.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: 5 by 9/29, ok

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: I'll make room on the shelf.

transcript.text: Done. Go.
